targets.rawSql: SELECT rows FROM analytics.dataset_inventory WHERE table_name = 'torrents'
SELECT rows FROM analytics.dataset_inventory WHERE table_name = 'wiki_pageviews'
SELECT sum(rows) FROM analytics.dataset_inventory WHERE table_name LIKE 'imdb_%'
SELECT rows FROM analytics.dataset_inventory WHERE table_name = 'swarm'
SELECT round(sum(pct_alive * torrents)) FROM analytics.a3_alive_by_upload_year
SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.a2_movie_first_upload

panels.title: Uploads per year by category (log scale)

targets.rawSql: SELECT year::text AS year, max(uploads) FILTER (WHERE category = 'adult') AS "adult", max(uploads) FILTER (WHERE category = 'tv') AS "tv", max(uploads) FILTER (WHERE category = 'movie') AS "movie", max(uploads) FILTER (WHERE category = 'music') AS "music", max(uploads) FILTER (WHERE category = 'game') AS "game" FROM analytics.a1_uploads_by_category_year WHERE year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2022 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT year::text AS year, max(share) FILTER (WHERE resolution = 'SD / unknown') AS "SD / unknown", max(share) FILTER (WHERE resolution = '720p') AS "720p", max(share) FILTER (WHERE resolution = '1080p') AS "1080p", max(share) FILTER (WHERE resolution = '2160p (4K)') AS "2160p (4K)" FROM analytics.a1_movie_resolution_share_long GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
SELECT release_year::text AS release_year, median_days_to_leak AS "first torrent on RARBG", median_window_days AS "legal home release" FROM analytics.a2_movie_leak_by_year ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Source of each film's first torrent

targets.rawSql: SELECT release_year::text AS release_year, max(share) FILTER (WHERE source = 'CAM / TS') AS "CAM / TS", max(share) FILTER (WHERE source = 'WEB') AS "WEB", max(share) FILTER (WHERE source = 'TV') AS "TV", max(share) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Disc') AS "Disc", max(share) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Other / unknown') AS "Other / unknown" FROM analytics.a2_first_upload_source_mix_long GROUP BY release_year ORDER BY 1
SELECT release_year::text AS year, films, median_days_to_leak AS "median days", pct_within_7d AS "≤7 days", pct_before_home AS "before home rel." FROM analytics.a2_movie_leak_by_year ORDER BY 1
SELECT lang_group AS language, films, median_days_to_leak AS "median days", median_versions AS "median versions" FROM analytics.a2_leak_by_language ORDER BY films DESC

panels.title: A3 · Popularity decay — full catalog scan, 1.39M torrents
Torrents still alive (≥1 seeder), by upload year

targets.rawSql: SELECT added_year::text AS year, max(pct_alive) FILTER (WHERE category = 'movie') AS "movie", max(pct_alive) FILTER (WHERE category = 'tv') AS "tv", max(pct_alive) FILTER (WHERE category = 'game') AS "game" FROM analytics.a3_alive_by_upload_year WHERE added_year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY added_year ORDER BY added_year

panels.title: Seeders per title (all versions), by release year

targets.rawSql: SELECT title_year::text AS year, max(mean_seeders_per_title) FILTER (WHERE category = 'movie') AS "movie", max(mean_seeders_per_title) FILTER (WHERE category = 'tv') AS "tv", max(mean_seeders_per_title) FILTER (WHERE category = 'game') AS "game" FROM analytics.a3_title_decay_by_release_year WHERE title_year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY title_year ORDER BY title_year
SELECT category, replace(model, '_', ' ') AS model, round(coef::numeric, 3) AS coef, CASE WHEN best THEN '✓' ELSE '' END AS "best (AIC)" FROM analytics.a3_title_decay_fits ORDER BY category, aic

panels.title: A4 · Public interest vs piracy — English Wikipedia (Sep 2026) vs seeders (Oct 2026)

targets.rawSql: SELECT category, rho_views_seeders AS "current seeders", rho_views_torrents AS "torrent versions" FROM analytics.a4_spearman ORDER BY titles DESC
SELECT category, name, views_week AS "Wikipedia views (week)", torrents AS versions, seeders FROM analytics.a4_top_titles ORDER BY views_week DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: A5 · Games — Steam 2018–2022, ≥100 reviews (MLlib logistic regression, test AUC 0.83)
Change in odds of being pirated, per 1 SD
panels.description: Red = more likely to be on RARBG, blue = less. Standardized MLlib logistic regression coefficients.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN feature = 'log_price' THEN 'price (log)' WHEN feature = 'free' THEN 'free-to-play' WHEN feature = 'log_reviews' THEN 'popularity (log reviews)' WHEN feature = 'score' THEN 'review score' WHEN feature = 'years_since_release' THEN 'years since release' WHEN feature = 'single_player' THEN 'single-player' WHEN feature = 'online_pvp' THEN 'online PvP' ELSE 'genre: ' || initcap(replace(substr(feature, 3), '_', ' ')) END AS feature, odds_ratio_per_sd - 1 AS effect FROM analytics.a5_logit_pirated ORDER BY coef_std DESC
SELECT band, mean AS pirated FROM analytics.a5_pirated_by_band WHERE "by" = 'price'
SELECT band, mean AS pirated FROM analytics.a5_pirated_by_band WHERE "by" = 'popularity'

panels.title: A6 · Genres — torrent versions vs an equally popular film (MLlib OLS residuals)
Excess piracy by genre
panels.description: IMDb movies 2018–2022 with ≥1,000 votes. Model: log1p(torrents) ~ log(votes) + year.

targets.rawSql: SELECT genre || ' (' || films || ')' AS genre, excess_piracy FROM analytics.a6_genre_excess_piracy ORDER BY excess_piracy DESC
SELECT genre, films, excess_piracy AS "excess piracy", pct_pirated AS "on RARBG", median_votes AS "median IMDb votes" FROM analytics.a6_genre_excess_piracy ORDER BY excess_piracy DESC

panels.title: A7 · Swarms through the day — opentrackr, fixed panel, 10 Oct 2026
Seeders vs each torrent's daily average (= 100)

targets.rawSql: SELECT slot AS time, category AS metric, index AS value FROM analytics.a7_panel_by_slot ORDER BY 1
SELECT slot AS time, category AS metric, leech_per_seed AS value FROM analytics.a7_panel_by_slot ORDER BY 1
SELECT layer, table_name AS "table", rows, size_mb AS "size (MB)" FROM analytics.dataset_inventory ORDER BY rows DESC
